description:
Ji-Un is infatuated with the enigmatic Se-Jin, confessing his love daily despite constant rejection. Se-Jin, on the other hand, believes Ji-Un could never truly like him for who he is. However, when Ji-Un vows to stay by Se-Jin’s side no matter what, the two decide to officially go steady. As their romance blossoms, Ji-Un is elated…but he soon discovers Se-Jin's hidden, sadistic tendencies. And things only get more complicated, as it comes to light that Ji-Un's best friend In-Hyuk has been harboring feelings for him all this time! Will Ji-Un be able to accept Se-Jin for who he is and learn to love his lusty lover? Or will Se-Jin’s lechery leave him longing for his bestie's embrace?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
